candidates.statement: Payment authorization calls from order time out (~2s ReadTimeout), causing order 502s and gateway checkout 502s; payment p95 latency is ~4875ms while inventory/redis succeed.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment server-side cause of the latency (e.g., internal dependency) is not observed; only client-side timeouts and high p95 are established.

report.explanation: Traces show order->payment POST /v1/authorizations failing with transport ReadTimeout (~2s), propagating 502 to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout, while inventory/redis succeed. Payment p95 ~4875ms supports downstream latency as the bounded root cause.
